tooltip.ghostmod.connection: Immediately connect to or disconnect from the server using the current inputs.
tooltip.ghostmod.connection.unavailable: Manual connect/disconnect is only available while in a singleplayer world. Auto-connects upon joining a world.
tooltip.ghostmod.serverUri.line1: Enter the server URL starting with ws:// or wss:// (defaults to ws:// if omitted).
tooltip.ghostmod.serverUri.line2: Examples: ws://localhost, wss://ghost.example.com (enter the port in the Port field below).
tooltip.ghostmod.serverPort.line2: Typically 8887 for direct ws:// connections, or 443 for wss:// via a reverse proxy.
tooltip.ghostmod.serverPassword: Enter the password required to authenticate with the server.

error.ghostmod.url.portInUrl: Enter the port number in the Port field below, not in the URL
error.ghostmod.url.invalidHost: Please enter a valid host or URL

toast.ghostmod.disconnected.title: Ghost Mod
